status: future work; no experimental energy measurement has been performed

recommended_instrument.use_case: batched inference energy with a GPIO timing marker
recommended_instrument.limitation: An 8.8 to 50.6 microsecond single inference is too short for a reliable single-event waveform at 100 ksps; integrate long repeated batches.

higher_performance_option.sampling: 2 MS/s simultaneous current and voltage ADC; up to 1 MS/s output
higher_performance_option.use_case: higher-resolution transient and batch energy measurement

measurement_boundaries.name: board_3v3_boundary
measurement_boundaries.includes: ESP8266 module and 3.3 V board loads downstream of the selected rail
measurement_boundaries.excludes: USB input and any bypassed regulator losses
measurement_boundaries.warning: Confirm the exact NodeMCU power topology and prevent simultaneous back-powering from USB.

measurement_boundaries.name: complete_dev_board_5v_boundary
measurement_boundaries.includes: on-board regulator and other powered board components
measurement_boundaries.excludes: host computer and external network infrastructure
measurement_boundaries.warning: Use an instrument and supply configuration rated for the board's transient current.

conditions: Wi-Fi disabled for isolated model-kernel comparison
Wi-Fi connected but no transmission during marked batch for system-context comparison
experiment.trigger: Drive one GPIO high immediately before the inference loop and low immediately after it.
experiment.control: Record matched idle/no-op windows and subtract baseline energy using the same supply and firmware condition.
experiment.order: Randomize or interleave representations to reduce temperature and drift confounding.

illustrative_not_measured.assumption: 3.3 V and the ESP8266EX datasheet's 15 mA modem-sleep example current
illustrative_not_measured.warning: These products are theoretical sensitivity calculations, not estimates of the measured Wi-Fi-enabled NodeMCU experiment and not paper results.
